source_block.parva: Shalya Parva (Hrada-pravesha and Gada-yuddha sub-parvas) · late afternoon and night of the eighteenth day · Duryodhana in the lake, the mace duel, the breaking of the thighs, Balarama's wrath, Ashwatthama made commander
source_block.bori: BORI CE Shalya Parva, Debroy translation vol. 7 (chapter-group citations): the hunters reveal the lake; Yudhishthira's challenge and offer; Vasudeva's rebuke; Bhima accepts; Balarama arrives from his Sarasvati pilgrimage and the duel moves to Samantapanchaka; the duel; Vasudeva's counsel and Arjuna's thigh signal; the breaking of the thighs; Balarama's wrath restrained by Keshava; the closing chapters — Ashvatthaman consecrated commander by the fallen king.
source_block.gita_press: Gita Press Gorakhpur Mahabharata (Hindi, Shalya Parva, vulgate numbering = Ganguli): adhyayas 30–33 (the hunters, the challenge, the offer, Krishna's rebuke), 34 and 54–55 (Baladeva; to Samantapanchaka), 56–58 (gada-yuddha, Arjuna's signal, uru-bhanga), 60 (Baladeva's anger), 65 (Ashvatthama's abhisheka).
source_block.divergence: Section/adhyaya numbers follow the vulgate (Ganguli = Gita Press); BORI CE chapters are cited at chapter-group level only. Omitted for length: Balarama's long pilgrimage digression (§35–§54), the exchange of taunts before the duel, Duryodhana's lament and the omens after his fall, Krishna's dialogue with the fallen Duryodhana, Kripa and Kritavarma's presence at the consecration. 'Samantapanchaka' is narrated as the holy lakes (Parashurama's five pools) and drawn with the lake master. The thigh blow is shown only as a stylized flash in mid-leap — no wound.
source_block.chosen: Gita Press + BORI/Debroy overlap: the hunters and the lake, Yudhishthira's offer, Krishna's alarm, Bhima steps forward, Balarama's arrival and Samantapanchaka, the duel (strength vs skill), Krishna's word to Arjuna and the thigh signal, the blow as Duryodhana leaps, Balarama's wrath and Krishna's calming by the vow, Ashwatthama made commander at night. Ganguli for English wording.
source_block.notes: Not TV. Comic-mythology only; no gore, no bodies. Kripa, Kritavarma, Nakula, Sahadeva and the hunters are narrated only or absent. Krishna = Ep 04 lock (official, Avinash 2026-10-05). One new scene master (lake19) and one new character lock (balarama). Never attach Ep01 plate-wide-gold or any finished plate as an Imagine ref.
